mapper.select: SELECT basic_rate AS basicRate, gov_match_rate AS govMatchRate FROM military_saving_product WHERE bank_code = #{bankCode} AND rate_type = 'MATURITY' AND value_unit = 'MONTH' AND (min_value IS NULL OR min_value <= #{totalMaturityMonths}) AND (max_value IS NULL OR max_value > #{totalMaturityMonths}) AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT rate_ratio AS rateRatio, floor_rate AS floorRate, value_unit AS valueUnit FROM military_saving_product WHERE bank_code = #{bankCode} AND rate_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND ( (value_unit = 'MONTH' AND (min_value IS NULL OR min_value <= #{elapsedMonths}) AND (max_value IS NULL OR max_value > #{elapsedMonths})) OR (value_unit = 'RATIO' AND (min_value IS NULL OR min_value <= #{elapsedRatio}) AND (max_value IS NULL OR max_value > #{elapsedRatio})) ) AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1
SELECT min_limit FROM military_saving_product WHERE bank_code = #{bankCode} AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1
